question: Why did the GUI move only 4 of 29 documents?

scanned.evidence: progress text 'Analyzing file content: N files' and 'Finding the best folders for 29 files… %'; confirm dialog '29 files will be organized' — identical in runs 01-03

not_scanned.evidence: no skip/error notice; count equals inventory

scanned_but_not_content_analyzed.evidence: product exposes no per-file analysis state; fast mode off and vision on were verified, but per-file extraction success is not shown

omitted_from_model_input.evidence: no prompt/context inspector, no log trace (app log records only updater events)

omitted_from_model_response.evidence: no response parser diagnostics; 25 files merely appear under 未组织文件

rejected_during_response_parsing.evidence: no parse-error surface in any run

excluded_from_final_plan.evidence: '未组织文件 25 文件' in all three previews; confirm dialog '25 files will remain in place'

deliberately_left_in_place.evidence: GUI offers no per-file rationale; only run 03 encodes intent via 'To Confirm' folder names

genuinely_unresolved.evidence: run 03 places 扫描件.pdf in 'Document Identity To Confirm'; run 02 places it in '00_INBOX/PROJECT-CONFIRMATION' without a rationale

conclusion: The 4/29 ceiling is reproducible across three runs and is visible only as a plan-coverage fact. The GUI cannot attribute it to scanning, extraction, prompting, parsing or decisioning; those splits are NOT_VERIFIED rather than inferred.
